evidence: The temperature dependence of the sticking coefﬁcient (SC) of precursor molecules used in atomic layer deposition (ALD) was investigated. Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)hafnium (TEMAHf) and Pentamethylcyclopentadienyltitan-trimethoxid (Cp*Ti(OMe)3) were used in combination with ozone to deposit hafnium dioxide and titanium dioxide ﬁlms at different substrate temperatures.
